elements.label: About
elements.value: Character mass affects force response; restitution controls how much the character bounces off surfaces.

onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/mass_bounce.schema.json, set mb_c_bounce to {{mb_c_bounce}}]
Set restitution to {{mb_c_bounce}} preset. None=0.0, Low=0.3, Bouncy=0.8.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/mass_bounce.schema.json, set mb_t_mass to {{mb_t_mass}}]
Set CharacterForceControllerBase.mass to {{mb_t_mass}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/mass_bounce.schema.json, set mb_t_restitution to {{mb_t_restitution}}]
Set KinematicForceController.restitution to {{mb_t_restitution}}. 0=no bounce, 1=full bounce.
